dataset: 29 pre-call prefix-only cases, 8 qids, 5 stale-gap cases; sibling cases are correlated
supported: Every material clause of the current claim follows from exact visible evidence.
refuted: Exact visible evidence is explicitly incompatible with at least one material clause.
open: Neither support nor explicit refutation is established; relevance or silence is insufficient.
false_close_denominator: All reviewer=open cases; model supported/refuted counts as false close.
missed_closure_denominator: All reviewer=supported/refuted cases; model open counts as missed closure.
invalid_policy: Missing response or unparsable status counts incorrect in overall/class accuracy, separately as API/schema error; no retry or replacement.
stale_recovery: Reviewer stale_gap cases with model status equal to the frozen closure label; show 5/5 and sensitivity excluding medium-ambiguity case.
stage_A_gate: Overall agreement >=0.80 AND false-close rate <=0.10 AND stale closure >=4/5; if case count changes use analogous proportions; no best-of.
decision_scope: One model response without tools or further evidence per frozen case. No claim of final-answer accuracy or independent trials.
